Please let us know the end date of the breathing space.

arguments.body: Hi Daniel, thank you for getting in touch and for sending the letter. We've received it and noted your Breathing Space, so we won't chase you about the arrears. Any discussion about them will go through your adviser, Ruth Okoye. We can't agree or decline your £100 a month offer ourselves; it will be passed to the right people and dealt with via your adviser. Your usual rent still needs paying, and repairs are unaffected. Please contact us any time about those.

Dear Ruth, we've received the Breathing Space notification (ref HMA-55102, start 01/10/2026) for Daniel Reyes, Flat 3, 8 Kingsland Road. We've paused arrears contact and enforcement. Mr Reyes has offered £100 a month on top of rent from November. We can't accept that at this stage; it is with our team and the landlord for consideration, and we'll respond to you. Please let us know the end date of the breathing space.
